kanagawa-saitama-chiba.description: Outer prefectures: workers exist per chome only (no per-building placement); employed residents exist per chome (employed.json) but the per-building split still uses total residents over OSM buildings by OSM tag (no land-use survey), so the placed resident count stays total_population.

quality.notes: answers = Tokyo 23 wards. Workers: 2021 Economic Census by chome (establishment-based, physical). Residents: employed residents (15+) by chome from the 2020 census small-area table 16-2 (employed.json; 1.8% of chomes are hidden cells split from published group totals) and per-building `emp` in tokyo-buildings.pmtiles; the engine uses commuters (od.json workers) as origin mass. Building placement: the official land use survey building polygons (tokyo-survey-buildings.pmtiles, 1.79M buildings, real use class and floors) = exact_footprints; per-use weights fitted by NNLS to census totals using the Tokyo land use survey (job-coefficients.json R2 0.85, pop-coefficients.json R2 0.74, emp R2 0.75) = fine_types_calibrated. O/D: 2020 census municipality x municipality full matrix (od.json), employed = od workers + workplace-not-stated for all 242 municipalities. Tiers are self-assessed and not reviewed by the registry.
